## Hypothesis

Scheduled tasks that invoke the venv pythonw stub cause hidden console windows to flash during execution, degrading user experience per L316. Switching to system pythonw with explicit PYTHONPATH eliminates these windows while maintaining identical functionality, as the venv stub merely adds an unnecessary indirection layer.

## Mechanism

Audit all scheduled tasks in `automation/overnight/` and `setup/scripts/` that invoke `.\.venv\Scripts\pythonw.exe` or similar venv-stub paths. Replace each invocation with:
- System `pythonw.exe` (from base Python installation)
- `PYTHONPATH` environment variable set to include:
  - `C:\Users\jackw\Desktop\42`
  - `C:\Users\jackw\Desktop\42\autoresearch`
  - `C:\Users\jackw\Desktop\42\backtest\lib`
  - Any other paths required for module resolution (verified via `import sys; print(sys.path)` in venv)
Preserve all existing command-line arguments and working directories. Validate via task scheduler history and runtime observation logs.
